svg.title: A forecast that means what it says
svg.desc: A schematic reliability diagram: calibrated forecasts land inside the contract's five-point band. Steps: 1. A 10% forecast should come true about one time in ten. 2. Overconfident forecasts fall off the diagonal. 3. Each contract fixes 3 pass thresholds in advance. 4. A model passes only when it clears all of them. Sources: The Readiness Loop README.

g.text: Reliability within five points per bin

text.tspan: A 10% forecast should come true about one time in ten.
Overconfident forecasts fall off the diagonal.
Each contract fixes 3 pass thresholds in advance.
A model passes only when it clears all of them.
A schematic reliability diagram: calibrated forecasts land inside the contract's five-point band.
